name: Noachian-Palimpsest
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by bioluminescent seas. Farther poleward, past an orbital debris ring, the silence feels older than the soil.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Leviathan fauna breach the sea-mist at dusk, singing on frequencies felt in the teeth.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
There is money in rare flora and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
